summary: Author's own review against the critic checklist (no independent critic was run). Seven romance sets (content/events/romance/): spark beats before the confession that learn or pay off a fact, partner beats (a tradition, a quarrel, a crisis), an ex card through soc_ex_encounter, and each character's own version of the generic cards they didn't fit (specializes:); migration 0039 stops the rest of those generics casting them. Plot safety: Kael's cards read only his cold hands, his mother and the North (nothing of his family's purpose or the lake); Nessa's never touch her red-string story. Fixed during review: soc_friend_sick is the friend being ill, so Tobias's version has him ill; two options were obviously best (Kael's 'Proud of You' and 'One Thing a Month' now trade spark against friendship); a capitalised phrase read as a proper noun; Nessa's spark beat explains the phrase that stops her quill without her using it, so her confession stays the first time the quill is still.

issues.problem: The plan gated every confession on having no partner; that would make soc_two_timing (two partners, a designed incident) unreachable.
issues.fix: Confessions gate on not being an ex only; recorded in PROGRESS.md as a deviation.

issues.problem: nessa.off_record is unlocked by the confession; learning it earlier could contradict the confession's 'first time you've seen it still'.
issues.fix: She names the phrase as a definition and doesn't say it to the quill; the quill keeps writing.

issues.problem: The plan's crisis read kael_kindness; it only exists for players who offered him bread on his first night.
issues.fix: The flag picks the line, not whether the card plays.

issues.problem: The plan moved the jibe to Corvin's voice; Bram and Ilse still use it in earnest.
issues.fix: Corvin joins the cast with his own fond version (corvin_saint_jibe); Bram and Ilse keep the generic.
